_comment: Known corrections applied on top of CFBD by scripts/build_game_sites.py. Each rule matches a team pair over an inclusive season range. site is "neutral" or the home team's name. An optional city only lets the rule fire when front_porch_games.json agrees on where the game was played (or has no city).

overrides.note: Iron Bowl was played at Legion Field, Birmingham from the 1948 renewal through 1988; Auburn first hosted at Jordan-Hare in 1989.
